messages:
olivia: Heads-up — final pre-publish dry-run for py/ts SDKs during the 11:00–12:00 PT change window. Two potential blockers: signer/key rotation + ephemeral CI creds. Need alignment on publish cadence and rollback criteria. @mike @sara @nora

mike: I can run the dryrun on canary and shadow registries. Plan:
1) make release-dryrun (build wheels + tgz)
2) push to shadow registry (npm:@shadow / pypi:@shadow)
3) smoke install + run quick e2e
4) verify signatures (gpg --verify)

Commands I'll run:
```bash
make release-dryrun
python -m pip install --index-url https://pypi.shadow/simple redwood-sdk==canary
npm install @redwood/sdk-canary --registry https://npm.shadow/
gpg --verify dist/*.asc
```

mike: ETA first pass in ~18m. I'll post logs in thread.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: canary publish job queued by mike. Job id: RB-5112. Scheduled start: 11:30 PT. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/RB-5112

sara: Rollback criteria we agreed earlier (copying here):
- packaging/install failure (pip/npm install fails)
- signature mismatch or missing signed artifacts
- regression >5% on smoke e2e for critical flows (auth, generation)
If triggered: pinback stable tag to previous commit, yank canary tags, revoke publish job (if in progress), and open a rollback PR for packaging fixes. Also notify customers via #release-notes and update changelog.

dan: Quick smoke log (from local dry install) — failing import: 
```
ERROR: Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/redwood/__init__.py", line 3, in <module>
    from .client import Client
ImportError: cannot import name 'Client' from 'redwood.client' (unknown location)
```

dan: That looks like __all__ or export/packaging issue on the wheel. Repro on node side: ts package missing index export for `createClient`.

mike: ack, repro. Investigating packaging script that assembles package.json/files and wheel manifest. If it's the export omission, we'll hold publish and trigger rollback plan. ETA 20m for root cause. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

nora: Security/KMS note: last week's KMS key rotation changed signing key id to 0xABCD1234. Verify that CI signing step uses the new key and that ephemeral creds for the publish runner include access to projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*. If using ephemeral JSON creds, ensure GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS is set in the runner.

mike: Confirmed CI is still pointing to old key in release.yml. I'll update the signing step if we proceed. If not fixed, signatures will fail and we MUST abort.

olivia: For release notes: call out deprecation of legacy sync client in Python + note about auth config change (service account vs env var). Keep messaging minimal and prepare a short blurb for marketing.

sara: TL;DR for ops:
- If all clear by 11:45 PT -> proceed with staggered publish (canary -> 10% shadow clients -> full)
- If any blocker -> cancel publish, set package-tag 'stable' -> previous SHA, yank canary, and run hotfix branch for packaging/signing.
- Communicate rollback in #release-notes and email customers in the next hour.

mike: Running expanded smoke now, attaching short output here (will upload full logs to CI link).

mike: [attachment] smoke-output.log — shows same import error on py, missing export on ts package.

olivia: Good catch. New plan: hold the window at 11:30, do NOT promote canary. Mike and dan triage packaging + manifest, nora confirms KMS mapping, sara prepares rollback PR template and customer comms. If we fix within 30m, we can re-open a quick patch publish in the same window; otherwise move to contingency window tomorrow morning.

sara: I'll pre-fill rollback PR and pinback script: `./scripts/pinback.sh --pkg redwood-sdk --from-tag stable --to-sha <prev_sha>` and notify registry admin to unlist canary if pushed.

mike: working on a fix: adding export in __init__ and updating package.json files list. Pushing branch `fix/packaging-exports`. Running local wheel build to confirm. ETA ~12m.

dan: once mike confirms, let's run a focused smoke (auth + basic generate) before we touch staging. No more full rollout until sign-off here.

olivia: Thanks team. Keep updates short here. I'll be on standby to approve either proceed or run rollback.
